title: News-desk editorial policy for Updates and Agent Zoo
description:
Write web/content/blog/AGENTS.md as the editor guide. One-line pointer from root AGENTS.md. Do not dump this into the engineering AGENTS.md.

Must state: the beat (persistent multi-agent workplaces; jargon moves), who is in the zoo, Updates vs Agent Zoo split, voice, how to publish.

Synonyms the desk covers, not names for the blog: software factory, bot farm, model zoo, agent org, reactor chamber (a chamber where AI agents collaborate and do useful work). Editors may add further synonyms for the same idea. The public masthead stays Agent Zoo.
